text:
The response accurately explains the central dogma and lists the main processes (replication, transcription, translation). It correctly credits Francis Crick, though it says he “proposed” it rather than explicitly stating he named/coined the term “central dogma.” It also omits some nuance about the dogma’s precise meaning regarding information flow and exceptions like reverse transcription. Overall, it is helpful, relevant, and mostly accurate.

Rating: [[8]]
